main_text.p: Sanctuarium] Adytum, Cæs. In occultis ac remotis templi, quò præter sacerdotes adire fas non est. Penetralia, Virg. Stat. Oraculum, Plin. Sanctum, & sancta, Plin. Item, Sancta sanctorum, in S. S.
Sanctus] Sanctissimus vir: sanctus & religiosus, Cic. vid. Sacer.
Sandalium] Solea, a. & Soleæ, Plin. Plaut. Socculus, Plin. Pantophellos, Bud. Sicyonii calcei, Cic. Sicyonia, Pl. Lucret. Diabathra, Pl. En. Græcanicæ soleæ (sunt muliebres,) Fest.
Sanè] Salubriter, Liv. Salubrius refrigerari, Cic. Salu-berrimè miscetur aconitum medicamentis, Plin. Salutariter uti armis. Salvè, Plaut. Saniùs, Hor. Saniter, Afran.
Sanguinare] Sanguinant pedes, Plin. Manat sanguine cicatrix, Sen. Manat culter cruore, Liv.
Sanguis] Sanguen, priscè. En. Var. Balsamus vitæ. Ros vitalis.

Sanguinem mittere] Cic. Sanguinem detrahere, Cels. Minuere, Plin. Dimittere ex capite, Tar. Detrahere ex, Col. Mittere ex, Cels. Scarificatione demere sanguinem: emittere, Col. Sanguinem incisâ venâ mittere, Cels. Incidere alicui venam, Cic. solvere, rescindere, aperire, Col. Ferire, Cels. Virg. Resolvere venas, Tac.
Sanguinem exspuere] Cels. Exscreare, Id. Sputare sanguinem, Plaut. Rejicere, Plin. Vomere, Virg. Reddere sanguinem per os, Plin. Rumices rupi, Plaut.
Sanguineus] Sanguinolentus color, Ovid. Sanguilenta urina, Scribon. Subcruentus, Cels. Suffusus sanguis oculis, &, suffusi cruore oculi, Plin.
Sanitas] Corporis salus. Incolumitas. Integritas corporis, Cic. Salva salus, Plaut. Valetudo commoda, Quint. Valetudinis firmitas, Plin Incolume corpus, Lucr. v. Valere.
Sanus] Benè firmus. Bellè habet. Valens, Cic. Salvus, Ter.

page.notes: The head word "Saties" appears as printed; likely "Sanies" (Saniēs) misprinted. The entry "Sanguineus" reads "Sanguilenta" as printed. Lower-left faint marks are show-through and were omitted. Line "Sanitas" and "Sanna" spacing irregular in print.
